what: A horizontally swipeable card row moves one screen width every 5 seconds (to the left edge of the nearest card) over 2.5 seconds — easeInOutQuint (fifth-power in and out), so it barely moves for a long while, slides fast in the middle, then settles very slowly. Hovering pauses it, and swiping by hand stops auto-advance for 1 second. The first six cards are cloned at the end, and on reaching the end it quietly jumps back to the start for an endless loop. It rests when off screen.

options.every: Advance every how many seconds, default 5
options.clones: Number of front cards to duplicate behind, default 6
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Row holding the cards (child) — first child if none

note: Native horizontal scroll panel without a scrollbar, so it can be pushed with a finger on phones (swiping vertically scrolls the page). With reduced motion it does not advance on its own

from.where: index.html .gb-cases (customer case navy card row) — original .swiper.is-cases setInterval 5000 + smoothScrollTo(2500, easeInOutQuint)·first 6 cards cloned·pause on hover·1000ms rest after scroll
